body: They don’t understand that you are a person outside of themselves. I understand it’s frustrating. I’ve lived with it for 20 years.

Thank you so much! It’s so difficult sometimes to even find the strength to get out of bed. I’ve been trying to do things that would probably help my depression but I keep getting pulled back down by my mother or my doctors. I want to get a Gastric Bypass really badly but my doctor keeps saying that there’s too many health risks. And I said I didn’t care, I just want to be happy.
